Still stuck

Confirm host URL, role, and whether you are on demo versus local. Capture correlation ids from failed API JSON when available. Avoid pasting secrets into shared tickets. For deploy failures, see Operations; for authz failures on CLI, see exit code 2 in CLI and keys.
